meta.title: Niu Lai: Escape in the Fog
language.label: Language
gate.title: Enter the Grassland
gate.description: There is something waiting for you in the fog. Once you've chosen your character, don't stop or look back.
gate.flashWarning: Warning: The game contains strong but low-frequency flickering and startling images.
brand.subtitle: Escape in the Fog
hud.defaultMission: Go through the fog and don’t look back.
title.name: Niu Lai
title.subtitle: Escape in the Fog
title.description1: The sun won't set. They won't stop in the fog.
title.description2: Pass through the herds and dead woods, and reach the end of the grassland alive.
menu.sprint: Hold to crawl faster; release to recover stamina
install.title: Install Niu Lai
install.default: Select "Add to Home Screen" from the browser menu.
install.already: Niulai has been installed as an application on this device.
install.wechat: First click the compass in the lower right corner to open the game in Safari; then click the share button and select "Add to Home Screen".
install.ios: Click the share button (square up arrow) at the bottom of the browser and select "Add to home screen."
install.other: Open your browser menu and select "Install app" or "Add to home screen."
scores.title: High Scores
result.winTitle: There is still grassland behind the door.
result.win:
Escape distance {distance} meters · Time taken {time}
In the distance, mother’s voice came again.
result.defaultDeath: They knocked down the cattle and tore at them for a long time in the rain.
story.0: Mom said: Don't mess with the grass snake.
story.2: Bao La: You go first, I will lure them away.
story.4: Mom said: I will meet you later.
story.5: Skylark: A bigger monster is coming.
story.6: Underneath the cliff...maybe there's a meadow.
herd.flee.0: The cow in front noticed the herd and began to run away desperately.
herd.flee.1: The shiny cow suddenly accelerated - it was no ordinary cow.
herd.flee.2: Another cow burst out of the grass, followed closely by the black-faced beast.
herd.flee.3: It's still running. The gasping sounds from behind were getting closer.
herd.flee.4: The herd on the left dispersed, and one fell behind.
herd.flee.5: There was the sound of hooves in the rain, and another cow was running for its life.
herd.flee.6: The last cow was also targeted by them.
herd.caught.0: The first cow was knocked down. Its cry soon died away.
herd.caught.1: They bit the cow's hind legs and dragged it into the grass.
herd.caught.2: The cow almost got away from them, but was surrounded by a puddle.
herd.caught.3: It's still struggling. The black-faced beast has torn open the belly of the cow.
herd.caught.4: The lone cow was knocked over, and its blood flowed down in the rain.
herd.caught.5: The sound of hooves stopped. Only the sound of chewing was left in the fog.
herd.caught.6: In the end, the cow failed to escape. They ate it.
event.otherworld: The alarm went off. The prairie is becoming something else.
event.more: More monsters are surrounding you from both sides.
event.car: The unmanned car came - but the things behind it didn't disperse.
event.tired: No stamina. Release RUN and catch your breath.
event.snowStart: The Snow Night of No Return: a woman is calling your name. Do not stop. Do not answer.
event.snowNear: She has no footprints. She was clearly in front just now.
event.snowEnd: The snow stopped. But there was still the sound of a woman stepping on the snow behind her.
event.superCow: Super Bull shook off the monster, rushed out of the exit, and ran away!
event.maul: Niu Lai was knocked down. They are tearing into him.
event.exitNear: The glowing exit is just ahead!
event.enemyNear: The enemy is approaching. Change the direction!
death.snow: The female ghost in the snow clung to Niu Lai's back, and then the monsters in the mist surrounded him and bit him.
death.enemy: {enemy} knocked down the cow, biting open the fur, and the blood mixed with the rainwater.
death.snake: The grass snake entangled Niulai's limbs, and then the monster rushed to knock it down and bite it.
death.tree: The twisted tree trapped Niu Lai. The things behind him pounced, until the rain ran completely red.
death.bird: Bird droppings fell from a strange bird in the fog and struck Niu Lai down.
event.birdHit: A strange bird hit you with its droppings!
event.birdNpcKilled: A strange bird’s droppings struck and killed a refugee.
chapter.1.title: Grassland Escape
chapter.1.description: Through the rain, the herd, and the hunters.
chapter.1.mission: Cross the grassland alive and find the first safe zone.
chapter.2.title: Forest of Fog
chapter.2.description: Forks in the road lie, and the observer hides behind the trees.
chapter.2.mission: Enter the misty forest and look for the traces left by your mother.
chapter.3.title: Snow Night of No Return
chapter.3.description: Blizzard covered the footprints, and my mother's voice came from the wrong direction.
chapter.3.mission: Make your way through a blizzard; stop in shelter to recuperate.
chapter.4.title: The Otherworld
chapter.4.description: Alarms sound and the grassland turns into a rust quarantine zone.
chapter.4.mission: Avoid strange cars and iron fences, and look for exit lights that are still on.
chapter.5.title: The Beast Tide
chapter.5.description: Everything is awake. Follow the herd towards the real exit.
chapter.5.mission: Don't trust the first exit. Follow the super cow.
safe.enter: It's warm here for now. You can leave, or you can stay and listen to them.
safe.break: The safe zone is shattered - everyone is running away!
safe.warm.0: The rain is heavy outside. Stay by the fire for a while.
safe.warm.1: I saw Super Cow moving forward.
safe.warm.2: Mom came here just now and she left a piece of cloth.
safe.warm.3: It's safe here...at least for now.
safe.cold.0: Why does fire have no shadow?
safe.cold.1: Did you hear anyone counting us?
safe.cold.2: That was not my mother just now.
safe.cold.3: There are more and more things standing outside the door.
task.clothMission: Find the red cloth pieces and open the forest gate ({count}/{total})
task.shelterMission: The blizzard will eat you up. Look for cabins, stop and hide.
task.sheltered: The cabin is safe for now. Don't let it hear breathing.
task.falseExit: Fake. The door rots before you.
task.trueExit: The fake exit is closed - the real exit is on the right!
task.stampede: The beast tide is coming! Follow the super cow to crawl towards the real exit!
item.herb: Herb collected: restore one heart and all stamina
item.flashlight: Flashlight collected: the fog clears briefly
item.radio: Radio collected: hear nearby monsters sooner
item.smoke: Smoke bomb collected: deploys automatically when monsters approach
ending.loop: Ending: Trapped in the Endless Grassland
roadNpc.0: Don't run after me. There are still live cattle in the front fence.
roadNpc.1: I heard my mother shouting in the fog, but the sound came from underground.
roadNpc.2: As soon as the fire is out, walk away. Safe zones are never really safe.
roadNpc.watcher: The shadow didn't open his mouth, but a voice came from behind you: Keep walking.
passingNpc.0: Do not stop! They always take whoever falls behind.
passingNpc.1: You can breathe inside the fence ahead, but do not stay long.
passingNpc.2: I just saw a cow dragged into the fog.
passingNpc.3: Do not trust the voice calling “Mama” in the fog.
passingNpc.4: Save your strength. There is still a long way to go.
passingNpc.5: If I fall behind… do not look back.
event.npcShoved: You push the blocking survivor aside with one finger.
controls.shove: Reach out and push an ally aside
